prompt: Ocak 2022 dönemindeki perakende satış tutarı bilgisini raporla.
scope: actual production API and connected database
sql:
SELECT SUM(INVOICE.[NETTOTAL]) AS satis_tutari
FROM [dbo].[LG_211_01_INVOICE] AS INVOICE
WHERE INVOICE.[CANCELLED] = 0
  AND INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7)
  AND INVOICE.[DATE_] >= '2022-01-01' AND INVOICE.[DATE_] < '2022-02-01'
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS amount FROM (SELECT SUM(F.NETTOTAL) AS amount FROM dbo.LG_211_01_INVOICE F WHERE F.CANCELLED=0 AND F.TRCODE IN (7) AND F.DATE_ >= '2022-01-01' AND F.DATE_ < '2022-02-01' UNION ALL SELECT SUM(F.NETTOTAL) AS amount FROM dbo.LG_411_01_INVOICE F WHERE F.CANCELLED=0 AND F.TRCODE IN (7) AND F.DATE_ >= '2022-01-01' AND F.DATE_ < '2022-02-01') AS firms
